title: Umthunywa Owajongana Nabanquli-zithixo
intro: Ngexesha apho ukuzinikela kwakulahlekile, umthunywa waphakama ebiza ukuba abuyele kunqulo lweNkosi yehlabathi. Lo mntu wema eqinile nxamnye nabantu ababenamathele kunqulo lothixo wobuxoki, ebakhumbuza ngoMdali wabo wokwenene neNkosi yooyisemkhulu babo. Sekunjalo abantu abazange banyamekele baza bala isilumkiso, betywina ikamva labo. Ngubani lo mntu ubizayo ongagungqiyo?
clues: Ndathunyelwa kubantu ababephambukile kwindlela kaThixo Omnye Oyinyaniso.
Ndibabuzile abantu bam, "Aniyi kumoyika na uAllah?"
Ndibabizele ukuba bayeke ukunqula uthixo wobuxoki ogama linguBhahali.
Abantu bam bala ubizo lwam baza baqhubeka nokunqula izithixo.
Ngenxa yokungavumi kwabo, ngokuqinisekileyo baya kuziswa ukuze bohlwaywe.
INkosi yam indinike uxolo nesikhumbuzo esisikelelekileyo phakathi kwezizukulwana ezizayo.
